capabilities: create and edit work-card notes by clicking dates on a month calendar
color-code cards by work category and show status dots and output-path flags
set date ranges that render as bars across calendar cells
pre-select work category from previous cards or keyword rules
migrate old-format card notes to the current note format
extras: The plugin interface is Korean only. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It makes no network requests and stores cards as YYYY-MM-DD title.md files in a configurable folder.
problem: Obsidian has no month-calendar view for treating dated notes as work cards with category colors, statuses, and date ranges.
summary: Month calendar that stacks daily work cards, where each card is one note color-coded by work category, status, and output path.
